_about: EAC auto-update app registry for the KEV remediation API-direct path. An exposed device whose KEV'd software matches an entry here is AUTO-PATCHED by adding it to that app's KEV-Remediate-<appKey> group (a windowsAutoUpdateCatalogApp assigned Required + auto-update). Software with NO entry here, excludeFromAutomation=true, not in the catalog (e.g., Edge), or on a non-Entra device, falls through to the ServiceNow ticket + email path. Drafting assistance: Claude Opus 4.8 (via GitHub Copilot), grounded in Microsoft Learn (windowsAutoUpdateCatalogApp, mobileAppAssignment groupAssignmentTarget, Defender SoftwareVulnerabilityChangesByMachine).

fallback._note: Invoked when: software not listed here, excludeFromAutomation=true, product absent from the Enterprise App Catalog, or device not Entra-resolvable. ServiceNow ticket is created via KEV-ServiceNow-v1; email via Graph sendMail.

_apps_note: softwareVendor / softwareName are the LOWERCASE tokens MDVM returns (match what MDETVM/SoftwareVulnerabilityChangesByMachine reports - verify with the Defender vuln export). catalogProduct must match the Enterprise App Catalog productDisplayName (run Onboard-EacAutoUpdateApp.ps1 -DumpCatalog). branchId is filled in by onboarding; the engine resolves the group by name (groupPrefix + appKey).

schema.apps[].appKey: string - stable id; also the group suffix (KEV-Remediate-<appKey>)
schema.apps[].catalogProduct: string - Enterprise App Catalog productDisplayName to resolve the auto-update branch
schema.apps[].softwareVendor: string - lowercase MDVM SoftwareVendor token to match exposure rows
schema.apps[].softwareName: string - lowercase MDVM SoftwareName token to match exposure rows
schema.apps[].branchId: string - mobileAppCatalogPackageBranchId (filled by onboarding; the windowsAutoUpdateCatalogApp tracks the latest package in this branch)
schema.apps[].excludeFromAutomation: bool - true => skip auto-patch, force ServiceNow+email fallback (e.g., change-board-gated apps)
